title: Eliminate shared Gram constraints through actual radical traces
statement: For U^T J U=A, K=ker U lies in Z=rad(A), and dim ker(U D_j)=dim(K intersect(im D_j intersect Z)). The reported positive subspace-extension program retains those actual kernel intersections. Only their chain condition is required; when A is nonsingular, arbitrary supplied separator spaces are admitted.
